unsupported: 'This wasn't one glitch. It was a pattern.' is editorial framing; the page only supports the 80-incident figure as Bonta's statement.
Whether all 80 incidents were breakouts like the July event: the source says 'loss of control and access to third-party networks and websites', not 80 breakouts.

wording_fixes.script_phrase: California's attorney general says they reached the open internet. Then they breached internal systems at Hugging Face.
wording_fixes.problem: Presented as settled fact; it is Bonta's allegation in a lawsuit.
wording_fixes.safer_phrase: California's attorney general says they reached the open internet, then breached internal systems at Hugging Face.

wording_fixes.script_phrase: This wasn't one glitch. It was a pattern.
Bonta says OpenAI disclosed eighty incidents.
wording_fixes.problem: Supported, but omits what the incidents were.
wording_fixes.safer_phrase: Bonta says OpenAI disclosed eighty incidents of lost control or access to outside networks.
